caption: The video showcases a small cube-shaped glass aquarium resting on a light wooden table, propped at its corners by tiny wooden blocks. Inside, multicolored gravel surrounds several green plastic plants. Orange and gold fish drift through the water against a plain black background. One hand grips the lower-left corner of the tank, fingers curled along its base. A second hand rests at the upper rim, its fingers visible through the refracted water. As the clip continues, the hand at the lower-left corner progressively straightens its fingers and slides outward to the left. It eventually lifts away, so the open, spread hand hovers in front of the glass face without touching it. The upper hand likewise withdraws, rising and moving out of the top of the frame, its refracted trace at the rim fading away. Throughout, the aquarium, gravel, plants and wooden corner supports remain fixed, while the surface reflections shift and the fish keep swimming.
